plans.idea: Faithful to the original's two-column structure: brand strip top-left, headline and feature copy as a left column, bottle in a right column centred on the copy, and the orange 'Taste the Difference' pill anchoring the bottom-left on the same left edge.

Centred vertical poster: small brand mark at top, the bottle as a centred focal image, the full-width copy block beneath it, and the pill centred at the bottom on the same axis, so the eye reads straight down the middle.

Copy-led layout: the headline and feature copy take a wide band across the top, then the bottom splits into the pill and brand/legal on the left and the bottle anchored bottom-right, so the message comes first and the product closes the composition.
